data.title: 妮芙 · 充气浮圈上摇晃果味棒冰的俏皮惊吓
data.action: 整个人趴在黑粉双色巨大甜甜圈浮圈上，单手托腮，另一手把咬了一半的荧光粉棒冰举在眼前晃动，露出坏笑
data.location: 波浪涌动的人工造浪海滨泳池深水区
data.lighting: 顶空炽烈骄阳洒在翻腾的白色浪花上，荧光色浮圈与棒冰在强光下格外鲜亮夺目
data.camera: high angle, dutch angle, medium shot
data.mood: 古怪俏皮、恶作剧般的兴奋与令人心跳加速的活力
data.description: 人造浪花一波接着一波撞击着浮圈。妮芙伏在甜甜圈浮圈中央，小巧的萨卡兹角在黑发间显得格外灵动，咬着滴水的冰棒冲你坏笑，粉色眼眸中闪烁着恶作剧的光芒——「呜哇！刚才的大浪差点把我掀翻了呢！不过……博士心跳加速的声音，好像比海浪的声音还要吵哦？嘻嘻，是在害怕溺水，还是在看着我心跳过速呢？」
data.promptProse: Nymph sprawls across a pink-and-black donut float in a sunlit wave pool at noon, wearing a neon berry-pink and black asymmetrical strappy bikini with heartbeat graphics and detached sheer fingerless sun sleeves. Propping her chin on one hand while waving a dripping pink popsicle with the other, she grins up at the viewer amid bright splashing waves.
data.animaCaption: Sprawled on her stomach across a pink-and-black donut float in her asymmetrical neon-pink bikini and detached sheer sun sleeves, she dangles a melting fruit popsicle and shoots a smug look upward. Bright midday sun sparkles over rolling wave-pool ripples.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a neon berry-pink and black asymmetrical strappy bikini printed with heartbeat pulse lines and paired with detached sheer fingerless sun sleeves.
